---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true

income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  state = "TX",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
income_tx |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::dollar) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income in Texas Counties",
    fill = "Income"
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_001", "B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE,
  summary_var = "B15003_001"
)
```
```{r}
edu_state |>
  filter(variable != "B15003_001") |>
  group_by(NAME) |>
  summarize(
    estimate = sum(estimate),
    summary_est = first(summary_est)
  ) |>
  mutate(percent = 100 * estimate / summary_est) |>
ggplot(aes(x = percent, y = reorder(NAME, percent))) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Educational Attainment by State",
    x = "Percentage with at Least a Bachelor's Degree",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: 2016-2020 American Community Survey"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
